# CV and ATS guidance

- Keep CV content aligned with the requirements and keywords of the target role so it is easy for applicant tracking systems (ATS) to parse and assess.
- When a target job description is provided, tailor the CV to it using relevant, truthful experience and terminology already supported by the source data. Never invent qualifications, skills, responsibilities, or results.
- Preserve clear, conventional headings and a simple, readable structure in the generated PDF.
- Treat ATS scores as dependent on the specific scoring system and job description. Do not promise or claim a score unless it has been measured with a named scoring tool; explain when a target score cannot be verified.
- CV content is maintained in `src/data/*.yaml` and validated at build time. Update those data files rather than hardcoding CV content in components.
